# kayjs-ai

> An LLM called from kay apps with no SDK and no streaming code: `ask()` over Anthropic or any OpenAI-compatible server (OpenAI, Ollama) through their HTTP APIs, a reply that streams into `await` blocks and into streaming actions as it is, and a scripted fake answering in development and tests.

## Topics

`bunx kay docs <words>` prints the section of these files or kay's that matches.

Each topic is one file, read whole with one command:

- [Environment, ask() and its reply](llms/asking.md): the variables, picking a provider, `ask()`'s options, an object instead of text (`schema`), the reply, `await` blocks and streaming actions
- [Chat island](llms/chat.md): `Chat(action={reply})`, its props, behaviour, markdown and the rules for passing it the action
- [Conversations kept on the server](llms/chat-conversations.md): `keepOnServer`, the server holding and replaying the history, `conversations` listing them with rename and delete, the tab left open elsewhere, the store
- [Floating chat](llms/chat-launcher.md): `ChatLauncher`, the chat behind a button at the bottom right of every page, and how its panel opens, closes and keeps the conversation, on the server too
- [Chat sources](llms/chat-sources.md): `ask({ sources })` and what `Chat` does with the `[n]` a reply cites: links, the cited list under the turn, `remember`, `initial`
- [Limits and the token budget](llms/limits.md): `ai({ rateLimit, budget, key })`, the stores, when tokens count, the `limited` error and a failing store
- [Personal data and the AI notice](llms/personal-data.md): what goes to the provider (US transfers, DPA, the privacy notice), what kayjs-ai keeps, the disclosure line `Chat` shows and how to word it
- [`kay i18n translate`](llms/translating.md): filling a locale's missing messages and localized entries as drafts, the checks on the model's reply, how an entry is marked, a run stopped half way
- [Images and PDFs](llms/attachments.md): `ai({ imageAlt })` drafting the alt of imported images, `attachments` on a message (bytes, `File`, `Blob`, a stored file), reading a scan into a `schema`, what each provider takes, `maxAttachmentBytes`, how files count against `maxInputChars`, `Chat`'s `attach`
- [Actions as tools](llms/tools.md): `tools` (actions, or `tool()` functions for a job with no visitor, `mocked(action, run)` to bench a prompt against the real model), `maxSteps`, what the model is told when a call goes wrong, `reply.progress()` and `reply.calls` for a chat to show the calls
- [Speech and embeddings](llms/speech-and-embeddings.md): `transcribe()` a recording, `speak()` a text, `embed()` texts into vectors over OpenAI's audio and embeddings API (a local server, Ollama, OpenAI), their variables, storing and searching vectors with pgvector, `ground()` answering from the app's own documents with cited sources, and the fake answering them
- [The fake, errors and providers](llms/testing-and-errors.md): scripting `fakeAi` in tests, `AiError` kinds, building a provider by hand, the dev tool tab
